obligations.title: Annual Report
obligations.applies_when: Domestic entities of the listed types: agricultural associations, common law trusts, LLPs, LPs, business corporations, nonstock corporations, LLCs, and cooperative associations.
obligations.due_rule: During the calendar quarter of the registration anniversary, each year after the registration calendar year.
obligations.quote: A domestic entity shall deliver its Annual Report to the Department in each year following the calendar year in which the entity registered, during the calendar year quarter in which the anniversary date of the registration occurs.
